title: Nafilah Fajr
introduction:
SUPPLICATION AFTER DAWN SUPEREROGATORY PRAYER

Recommended acts and litanies following the completion of the Night Prayer and dawn supererogatory units.

verses.translation: Upon accomplishment of the dawn nafilah prayer, sleep on the right side facing the kiblah, put your right cheek on your right hand, and say the following:
I have laid hold on Allah’s firmest handle
I have held fast to Allah’s solid rope.

verses.arabic: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَالْعَجَمِ
verses.translation: I pray for Allah’s protection against the evil of the sinful Arabs and non-Arabs.

verses.arabic: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شَرِّ فَسَقَةِ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ۔
verses.translation: I pray for Allah’s protection against the evil of the sinful jinn and men.
You may then repeat the following doxology (zikr) three times:
All glory be to the Lord of mornings, the Cleaver of daybreak.

You may then recite the previously mentioned five verses of SurahAl-’Imran.

You may then sit and say Tasbih al-Zahra’.

In the book of Man-La-Yahduruhul-Faqih, it is reported that whoever invoke blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household one hundred times between the supererogatory (mustahab / nafilah) and the obligatory dawn (fajr) prayers, Almighty Allah will save his face from the heat of Hellfire.

Whoever repeats the following supplicatory prayer one hundred times, Almighty Allah will build for him a house in Paradise:

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّىَ الْعَظِيْمِ وَ بِحَمْدِہٖ اَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ رَبِّىْ وَ اَتُوْبُ اِلَيْهِ۔‏
verses.translation: All glory be to my Lord, the All-great, and in praise of Him. I implore Allah, my Lord, for forgiveness and I repent to Him.

Whoever recites Surah al-Tawheed twenty-one times, Almighty Allah will build for him a house in Paradise, and whoever recites it forty times, Almighty Allah will forgive him.

After accomplishing the Night Prayer, it is highly advisable to say the thirty-second supplication of al-Sahifah al-Kamilah al-Sajjadiyyah:
O Allah, O Possessor of kingdom perpetual in everlastingness...

You may then do a thanksgiving prostration during which you are highly advised to pray for the good of your brothers-in-faith and say the aforementioned supplication that is said in the thanksgiving prostrations and begins with the following statement:

I please my faithful brothers to mention me - the sinful whose face has been blackened by sins - in their supplications, because I am in urgent need for prayers. Eventually, Allah is the source of success.
